title: Term Life Insurance Band Measurement with Ashgrove Permanent Coverage on the Insured — Waiver Removal
content:
**Term Life Insurance — band measurement face for the waiver removal reckoning** (the reckoning of the installment after the waiver of premium rider ends at its expiry age).

The band measurement face is chosen by the owner's Ashgrove permanent coverage on the same insured — in-force Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance policies on the insured's life:

| Permanent coverage on record for the insured (status in force) | Band measured on |
|---|---|
| An Ashgrove whole life policy and an Ashgrove universal life policy, both in force | the term face amount on record plus both permanent face amounts |
| Exactly one of the two in force | the term face amount on record plus that permanent face amount |
| Neither in force | the term face amount on record alone |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Term face 300000; in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 of 150000 and in-force Ashgrove Protection UL of 100000 on the insured: band measured on 550000.
- Term face 300000; the whole life policy on the insured has lapsed, an in-force universal life policy of 100000 remains: band measured on 400000.
- Term face 300000; no permanent policy in force on the insured: band measured on 300000.

The permanent policies are identified on the whole life and universal life policy records by the insured; only a policy whose status is in force counts.
